application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 15 (4) 1971:A) 1 x holly (T1): reduce and shape crown by up to 2m and crown lift to provide 3m clearanceB) 1 x ash (T2): reduce and shape crown by up to 3m and crown lift to provide 3m clearance, retain lower secondary stem, shorten lateral growth and shape by 2m.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

Crown reduction of the ash (T2) is not considered justified for the stated reason, given the unconstrained nature of the tree's location and its contribution to the character and appearance of the Bush Hill Park Hill Conservation Area. Notwithstanding this, some crown lifting and reduction or removal of the maturing shoots growing from the old cut stump close to the tree's base could be agreed, subject to the submission of a further application.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2017) as amended.
